content.text: You’ve spent months perfecting your beats. You’ve built an audience on Instagram and TikTok. But when it’s time to sell, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-which-architecture-actually-works-10|Stripe Alternatives]] and PayPal aren’t options. Kenya isn’t on their list. You’re forced into workarounds: middlemen who take 30%, platforms that shut down accounts, payment links that expire. This isn’t a business—it’s a gamble. What if you could own the infrastructure? No platforms. No subscriptions. No one between you and your customers. This is sovereign commerce: your beats, your store, your rules. Crypto payments verified on-chain. Files delivered instantly. Data stored where you control it. Built to survive payment rejection, currency collapse, and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/financial-sovereignty-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-broken-here-2|COREMERCH guide to digital]]-creators-crypto-honest-side-side-13|financial]] isolation. Pressure-tested in Zimbabwe. Deployed in 48 hours. This is how you sell beats online without permission.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-3. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Beats online

This is not a plugin or a SaaS tool. It’s a stack of infrastructure components you own. GitHub Pages hosts your store for free. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic. Supabase stores orders. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain. No platform controls your access. No subscriptions drain your revenue. You deploy it, you own it. The architecture is designed for digital creators selling beats, templates, or courses in regions where conventional payment processors are blocked. It’s not a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure. You price in USD, customers pay in crypto (BSC, Solana, TRON for low fees), and the system delivers your product the moment payment confirms. No buyer accounts. No KYC. Just direct transactions. This is how you stop renting and start owning.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here’s the flow: A customer lands on your GitHub Pages store. They select a beat and pay with crypto via NOWPayments. The payment hits the blockchain. A webhook triggers Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. The script verifies the payment, logs the order in Supabase or Google Sheets, and sends a secure download link via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The customer gets their beat instantly. You get paid directly to your wallet. No middlemen. No delays. The system is stateless—no servers to maintain. Files are stored redundantly. Payments are verified on-chain, not by a third party. This architecture is lightweight, fast, and resistant to failure. It’s built to handle 10 sales or 10,000. You control every component. You own every transaction.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is for digital creators who’ve been locked out of Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad. You sell beats, presets, templates, or courses. You have an audience but no way to collect payment. You’re tired of workarounds that fail or exploit you. This stack is built for you. It’s for creators in Kenya, Nigeria, Zimbabwe, and beyond who need infrastructure that doesn’t depend on someone else’s approval. It’s for creators who want to own their store, their data, and their revenue. It’s for creators who understand that sovereignty isn’t optional—it’s the only way to build a sustainable business. This isn’t a solution for those who want someone else to manage their store. It’s for those who want to manage their own.
Own your store. Own your data. Own your revenue.
The Components That Make It Work Together

GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your store for free. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments with a 0.5% fee. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files securely. Each component is free or low-cost. Each is open and interoperable. You can swap components as needed. For example, use Google Apps Script if you’re comfortable with JavaScript, or Cloudflare Workers for more advanced logic. Use Supabase for scalable databases, or Google Sheets for simplicity. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, so your customers can pay with what they have. The system is modular—you can start small and scale as you grow. The key is that you own every piece. No vendor lock-in. No single point of failure.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start with the Complete Builder Kit ($197). It includes all 6 blueprints, 7 templates, and instant access to the documentation. Deploy the Sovereign Starter Stack in 48 hours: GitHub Pages, Google Apps Script, NOWPayments. Load 3 products. Get 30 days of support. Or choose the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and advanced features. Follow the step-by-step guides. Copy the code. Deploy to your accounts. Test end-to-end. Once live, you own it. No COREMERCH access. No ongoing fees. Just your store, your beats, your revenue. This is how you stop waiting for permission and start selling on your terms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell beats online without Stripe or PayPal, deploy a sovereign commerce stack using GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, NOWPayments for crypto payments, and Google Drive for file delivery. Price in USD, accept crypto (BSC, Solana, TRON for low fees), and deliver beats instantly upon payment confirmation. Own the infrastructure—no platforms, no subscriptions, no middlemen.
No platforms. No subscriptions. No middlemen.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197). 2. Purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for all blueprints and templates. 3. Set up GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting. 4. Configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic. 5. Connect Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. 6. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. 7. Upload beats to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for secure delivery. 8. Test end-to-end: purchase, payment, and file delivery. 9. Deploy live. 10. Own your infrastructure.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this if I’ve never coded before?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes templates and step-by-step guides. Start with Google Apps Script and Google Sheets for simplicity. No advanced coding required.
What cryptocurrencies can my customers use?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommend BSC, Solana, or TRON for low transaction fees under $0.10.
Do I need to set up a crypto wallet?
Yes. You’ll need a wallet to receive payments. MetaMask or Trust Wallet are recommended. No KYC required.
Can I sell more than beats with this stack?
Yes. The architecture works for ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, plugins, and software. Any digital product.
What happens if a payment fails?
The system verifies payments on-chain. If payment fails, no download link is sent. The customer must retry. You retain full control.
